detail.longDescription: OpenClaw went viral. Meet the maintainers building and securing it. OpenClaw exploded into a leading open source project after launching Nov 2025, hitting 388K stars by Aug 2026. Maintainers share key lessons: adapt to AI-driven contributions, build inclusive communities, use AI tools for security review, manage dependencies carefully, and balance UX with safety. The GitHub Secure Open Source Fund proved invaluable for security knowledge & support. https:// github.blog/open-source/mainta iners/openclaw-went-viral-meet-the-maintainers-building-and-securing-it/ # AI # MachineLearning
